concept.concept_description: The Fibonacci sequence is defined by F(n+1) = F(n) + F(n-1) and converges to the golden ratio. Define the ANTI-Fibonacci sequence: A(n+1) is the smallest positive integer that is NOT equal to A(n) + A(n-1). The sequence begins 1, 1, 2, 4, 7, 11, 16, ... (each term avoids being the sum of the two previous terms). Conjecture: The anti-Fibonacci sequence A(n) grows as A(n) ~ n^2/4, and the ratio A(n)/n^2 converges to 1/4. More precisely, A(n) = floor(n^2/4) + O(1). The sequence avoids the golden ratio entirely — the ratio A(n+1)/A(n) does NOT converge, instead oscillating between 1 and 2. The complement of the anti-Fibonacci sequence (numbers that ARE sums of two previous anti-Fibonacci numbers) has density 0. Test: compute A(n) for n up to 10^6 and verify A(n)/n^2 approaches 1/4. Prove A(n) = floor(n^2/4) + O(1) by induction. Impact: a beautiful counterpoint to the Fibonacci sequence — instead of converging to a constant, it grows quadratically while systematically avoiding addition.

Prove the density conjecture by counting valid digit permutations. Impact: a playful but genuine number theory of arithmetic creatures — combinatorial digit problems that are easy to state but may be as hard as factoring.

import Mathlib

namespace CognitiveBraiding

/-- A cognitive process on `n + 1` regions: a list of firing events, each a
    generator index `i : Fin n` together with a crossing sign
    (`true = σ_i`, `false = σ_i⁻¹`). -/
abbrev CogProcess (n : ℕ) := List (Fin n × Bool)

/-- The signed contribution `±1` of a single crossing. -/
def csign (b : Bool) : ℤ := if b then 1 else -1

/-- The **writhe** (net directed activity, i.e. exponent sum) of a cognitive
    process. -/
def writhe {n : ℕ} (w : CogProcess n) : ℤ := (w.map (fun p => csign p.2)).sum

/-- **Additivity of information flow.** Writhe is additive under sequential
    composition (concatenation) of thoughts: `w(u ++ v) = w(u) + w(v)`.  This is
    the homomorphism property that makes writhe a well-behaved invariant. -/
theorem writhe_append {n : ℕ} (u v : CogProcess n) :
    writhe (u ++ v) = writhe u + writhe v := by
  simp [writhe, List.sum_append]

/-- The writhe of a process is bounded in absolute value by its length: each
    firing event changes the net charge by at most `1`. -/
theorem writhe_abs_le_length {n : ℕ} (w : CogProcess n) :
    |writhe w| ≤ (w.length : ℤ) := by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [writhe]
  | cons a t ih =>
    simp only [writhe, List.map_cons, List.sum_cons, List.length_cons, Nat.cast_add, Nat.cast_one]
    have hb : |csign a.2| = 1 := by rcases a.2 <;> simp [csign]
    have h1 : |csign a.2 + (t.map (fun p => csign p.2)).sum|
        ≤ |csign a.2| + |(t.map (fun p => csign p.2)).sum| := abs_add_le _ _
    have ih' : |(t.map (fun p => csign p.2)).sum| ≤ (t.length : ℤ) := ih
    rw [hb] at h1
    linarith

/-- The trefoil braid word `σ₀³` in `B₂` (one generator, index `0`): three
    positive crossings.  Its closure is the trefoil knot `3₁`. -/
def trefoilProcess : CogProcess 1 := [(0, true), (0, true), (0, true)]

    Any cognitive process carrying the same net writhe as the trefoil braid
    (`writhe = 3`) requires at least `3` firing events; and the trefoil word
    itself achieves both `writhe = 3` and length `3`, so the bound is tight.
    Topological charge forces a hard, tight lower bound on neural cost. -/
theorem trefoil_min_firings :
    (∀ w : CogProcess 1, writhe w = 3 → 3 ≤ w.length) ∧
      writhe trefoilProcess = 3 ∧ trefoilProcess.length = 3 := by
  refine ⟨?_, by decide, by decide⟩
  intro w h
  have hb := writhe_abs_le_length w
  rw [h] at hb
  have : (3 : ℤ) ≤ (w.length : ℤ) := by simpa using hb
  exact_mod_cast this

end CognitiveBraiding

    braid realised by a firing sequence equals (via `ofAdd`) the concrete list

import Mathlib

namespace CognitiveWritheBridge

/-! ## The braid group presentation (catalog convention) -/

/-- Far commutativity relations: `σ_i σ_j σ_i⁻¹ σ_j⁻¹` for `i + 1 < j`. -/
def farCommRels (n : ℕ) : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)) :=
  { r | ∃ (i j : Fin n), i.val + 1 < j.val ∧
    r = FreeGroup.of i * FreeGroup.of j * (FreeGroup.of i)⁻¹ * (FreeGroup.of j)⁻¹ }

/-- Braid (Yang–Baxter) relations. -/
def braidYBRels (n : ℕ) : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)) :=
  { r | ∃ (i : Fin n) (hi : i.val + 1 < n),
    r = FreeGroup.of i * FreeGroup.of ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩ * FreeGroup.of i *
        (FreeGroup.of ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩)⁻¹ * (FreeGroup.of i)⁻¹ *
        (FreeGroup.of ⟨i.val + 1, hi⟩)⁻¹ }

/-- The full set of braid relations for `B_{n+1}`. -/
def braidRels (n : ℕ) : Set (FreeGroup (Fin n)) :=
  farCommRels n ∪ braidYBRels n

/-- The braid group on `n+1` strands, with `n` Artin generators. -/
abbrev BraidGrp (n : ℕ) := PresentedGroup (braidRels n)

instance (n : ℕ) : Group (BraidGrp n) := inferInstanceAs (Group (PresentedGroup _))

/-- The `i`-th Artin generator `σ_i ∈ B_{n+1}`. -/
def sigma {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) : BraidGrp n := PresentedGroup.of i

/-! ## The writhe homomorphism `B_{n+1} → ℤ` -/

/-- Every braid relation maps to `1` under the constant lift to `Multiplicative ℤ`. -/
theorem braidRels_lift_one (n : ℕ) :
    ∀ r ∈ braidRels n,
      (FreeGroup.lift (fun _ : Fin n => Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ))) r = 1 := by
  rintro r (hr | hr)
  · rcases hr with ⟨i, j, hij, rfl⟩; simp_all +decide [mul_assoc]
  · rcases hr with ⟨i, hi, rfl⟩; simp +decide [mul_assoc]

/-- The writhe (exponent-sum) homomorphism from `B_{n+1}` to `ℤ`, sending each
    Artin generator `σ_i` to `1 ∈ ℤ`. -/
noncomputable def writhe (n : ℕ) : BraidGrp n →* Multiplicative ℤ :=
  PresentedGroup.toGroup (f := fun _ => Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ))
    (braidRels_lift_one n)

/-- The writhe sends each generator `σ_i` to `1`. -/
theorem writhe_sigma {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    writhe n (sigma i) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (1 : ℤ) := by
  unfold writhe sigma
  erw [QuotientGroup.lift_mk]

/-- The writhe sends each inverse generator `σ_i⁻¹` to `-1`. -/
theorem writhe_sigma_inv {n : ℕ} (i : Fin n) :
    writhe n (sigma i)⁻¹ = Multiplicative.ofAdd (-1 : ℤ) := by
  rw [map_inv, writhe_sigma, ← ofAdd_neg]

/-! ## The concrete list model of a cognitive process -/

/-- A cognitive process on `n + 1` regions: a list of firing events, each a
    generator index `i : Fin n` with a crossing sign (`true = σ_i`,
    `false = σ_i⁻¹`). -/
abbrev CogProcess (n : ℕ) := List (Fin n × Bool)

/-- The signed contribution `±1` of a single crossing. -/
def csign (b : Bool) : ℤ := if b then 1 else -1

/-- The concrete **list writhe** (exponent sum) of a cognitive process. -/
def listWrithe {n : ℕ} (w : CogProcess n) : ℤ := (w.map (fun p => csign p.2)).sum

/-- One firing event as an element of the braid group. -/
def eventBraid {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n × Bool) : BraidGrp n :=
  if p.2 then sigma p.1 else (sigma p.1)⁻¹

/-- Realise a whole cognitive process as an element of the braid group
    `BraidGrp n`, by multiplying the generators/inverses in order. -/
def toBraid {n : ℕ} : CogProcess n → BraidGrp n
  | [] => 1
  | p :: t => eventBraid p * toBraid t

@[simp] theorem toBraid_nil {n : ℕ} : (toBraid ([] : CogProcess n)) = 1 := rfl

@[simp] theorem toBraid_cons {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n × Bool) (t : CogProcess n) :
    toBraid (p :: t) = eventBraid p * toBraid t := rfl

/-- The writhe of a single event equals `ofAdd (csign …)`. -/
theorem writhe_eventBraid {n : ℕ} (p : Fin n × Bool) :
    writhe n (eventBraid p) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (csign p.2) := by
  unfold eventBraid csign
  cases p.2 with
  | false => simpa using writhe_sigma_inv p.1
  | true => simpa using writhe_sigma p.1

/-! ## The bridge theorem -/

/-- **Bridge theorem.** The group-theoretic writhe of the braid realised by a
    firing sequence equals (via `ofAdd`) the concrete list writhe of that
    sequence: the abstract abelianization `B_{n+1} → ℤ` and the hands-on sum of
    crossing signs are the *same* invariant of a thought. -/
theorem writhe_toBraid {n : ℕ} (w : CogProcess n) :
    writhe n (toBraid w) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (listWrithe w) := by
  induction w with
  | nil => simp [listWrithe]
  | cons p t ih =>
    have hlist : listWrithe (p :: t) = csign p.2 + listWrithe t := by
      simp [listWrithe]
    rw [toBraid_cons, map_mul, writhe_eventBraid, ih, hlist, ofAdd_add]

/-- The trefoil braid word `σ₀³` in `B₂`. -/
def trefoilProcess : CogProcess 1 := [(0, true), (0, true), (0, true)]

/-- The trefoil word realises a genuine braid-group element of group-writhe `3`. -/
theorem toBraid_trefoil_writhe :
    writhe 1 (toBraid trefoilProcess) = Multiplicative.ofAdd (3 : ℤ) := by
  rw [writhe_toBraid]

    sign-balanced sequence (equal multiset of `±1` signs, hence list-writhe `0`),

homology group, reducing a hard invariant to an arithmetic congruence.

the `d = 0` case; recognizing this pattern turns an isolated anomaly into a

Net topological charge (writhe) forces a tight lower bound on the number of
